candidate_comparison.dual_gain_hypothesis: Removing unsupported guarantees and making validated alternatives explicit can reduce wasted steps and incorrect claims; no guarantee it solves code generation.
candidate_comparison.strongest_alternative: Fixed actor construction capability dominates, so improved contracts/call counts do not change completion/core.
